user.title: Claude Usage
user.description: Provide a claude.ai OAuth token to read your subscription's rolling usage limits.

data_description.api_token: The claude.ai OAuth token is tried once before the entry is created and then used for every poll; it expires after a while, and Home Assistant asks for a new one.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two probe calls to the Anthropic API; default 300 seconds, allowed 60 to 3600.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored OAuth token was rejected by the Anthropic API — it has most likely expired. Fetch a fresh token from claude.ai and enter it here.

data_description.api_token: The new claude.ai OAuth token; it is tried once before it replaces the stored one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anthropic API.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected (401/403) — it is likely expired or invalid.
error.empty_token: The token must not be empty.

init.title: Claude Usage
init.description: Adjust how often the usage limits are polled, or put a fresh OAuth token in place.

data_description.api_token: Replaces the stored token from now on; leave the field empty to keep the current one.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two probe calls to the Anthropic API; default 300 seconds, allowed 60 to 3600.
